source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of electrophilic aromatic substitution (PDF 65-68).

blocks.text: Electrophile koi bhi ho, electrophilic aromatic substitution teen bare qadmon mein hoti hai.

items: Electrophile banana: electrophile, musbat ion ya polar molecule ka musbat sira, aam taur par seedha nahi milaya ja sakta; yeh munasib reagents se reaction mixture mein hi (in situ) banta hai.

Electrophilic hamla: ring ke pi electrons electrophile par hamla karte hain, jis se ring ke aik carbon aur electrophile ke darmiyan sigma bond banta hai. Is se aromaticity toot jati hai: sirf chaar pi electrons bachte hain, aur musbat charge baqi paanch carbons par phail jata hai. Yeh darmiyani halat sigma complex (arenium ion) hai.
Aromaticity ki wapsi: aik base (counter-ion) sp3 carbon se H hata deta hai. C-H bond heterolytic taur par toot'ta, us ke electrons pi nizam mein wapas jate, aur delocalisation bahal ho jati hai.

blocks.alt: Benzene, jis ki ring se E+ ki taraf mura teer (curly arrow); phir sigma complex: ring jis ke oopar wale carbon par H aur E, toota daira aur andar +, aur C-H bond se ring ki taraf mura teer. Doosra teer, Rapid step, E wala benzene aur H+ deta hai.
blocks.caption: Electrophilic substitution ka aam mechanism (kitab ke PDF safha 65 ki be-number figure ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Mura teer (curly arrow) electron ke jore ki harkat dikhata hai. Pehle qadam mein ring ke pi electrons E+ se naya sigma bond banate hain; ring ka musbat charge (+) baqi paanch carbons par phail jata hai, is liye daira toota hua dikhaya gaya hai. Doosre, tez (rapid) qadam mein C-H bond ke electrons wapas ring mein jate hain, H+ nikal jata hai aur aromatic ring wapas ban jati hai.

Benzene chlorine ya bromine se sirf Lewis acid ki maujoodgi mein react karta hai, jaise aluminium chloride (AlCl3), iron(III) chloride (FeCl3) ya iron(III) bromide (FeBr3), jo halogen se jur kar taqatwar electrophile banata hai. Bromination ke liye: C6H6 + Br2 -> C6H5Br + HBr (khushk AlBr3).

blocks.alt: Benzene + Br2, teer ke oopar AlBr3 aur neeche ANHYDROUS (be-aab, paani ke baghair), se bromobenzene + HBr.
blocks.caption: Benzene ki bromination (kitab ke PDF safha 65 ki be-number figure ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

items: Br2 + AlBr3 -> Br+ + [AlBr4]-: Lewis acid Br2 ko polarise kar ke electrophile banata hai.
Br+ ring par hamla karta, sigma complex banta.
[AlBr4]- sigma complex se H+ hatata: bromobenzene, HBr aur AlBr3 (catalyst) bante.

blocks.alt: Br-Br, baen Br par delta+ aur daen par delta-; mura teer delta- wale bromine se AlBr3 ki taraf. Teer ke baad Br+ + [AlBr4]-.
blocks.caption: Br2 aur AlBr3 se electrophile Br+ ka banna (kitab ke PDF safha 65 ki be-number figure ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.alt: Benzene, ring se Br+ ki taraf hara mura teer, se sigma complex jis ke aik carbon par Br aur H aur tootay daire mein +. [AlBr4]- se us H ki taraf mura teer, aur C-H bond se ring ki taraf mura teer. Teer ke baad bromobenzene + HBr + AlBr3.
blocks.caption: Benzene ki bromination mein Br+ ka hamla aur proton ka nikalna (kitab ke PDF safha 65-66 ki be-number figure ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Pehle AlBr3 (Lewis acid) Br-Br ko polar banata hai: AlBr3 se jura Br delta- aur doosra delta+ ho jata hai, aur bond toot kar Br+ (electrophile) aur [AlBr4]- bante hain. Kitab in partial charges ko 'sigma+' aur 'sigma-' likhti hai; sahi nishan delta+ aur delta- hai. Phir ring Br+ par hamla karti hai, aur [AlBr4]- sigma complex se H+ le kar HBr aur AlBr3 (catalyst wapas) banata hai.
Chlorination bhi aise hi hai, FeCl3 ya AlCl3 Lewis acid ke taur par Cl+ banata hai.
Benzene par nitro group garhe nitric aur sulphuric acids ke mixture se lagaya jata hai: C6H6 + HNO3 -> C6H5NO2 + H2O (conc. H2SO4).

blocks.alt: Benzene + HNO3, teer ke oopar H2SO4, se nitrobenzene + H2O.
blocks.caption: Benzene ki nitration (kitab ke PDF safha 66 ki be-number figure ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

items: Electrophile ka banna: H2SO4 + HNO3 <=> NO2+ + HSO4- + H2O. Nitronium ion NO2+ electrophile hai.
Hamla: ring ka electron jora NO2+ se jurta, sigma complex banta aur aromaticity khatam hoti.
Substituted carbon ka C-H bond toot'ta aur us ke electrons pi nizam mein lautte, ring bahal: nitrobenzene banta.
Catalyst ki wapsi: HSO4- + H+ -> H2SO4.

blocks.alt: Teen qadam. Electrophile ka banna: H2SO4 + HNO3 aur NO2+ + HSO4- + H2O ke darmiyan equilibrium (tawazun), NO2+ par electrophile ka nishan. Electrophile ka hamla: benzene ring se NO2+ ki taraf mura teer, aik carbon par H aur NO2 wala sigma complex; C-H bond se ring ki taraf mura teer, nitrobenzene + H+. Catalyst ki wapsi: HSO4- + H+ se H2SO4, catalyst ka nishan.
blocks.caption: Benzene ki nitration ka mechanism (kitab ke PDF safha 66 ki be-number figure ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Sulphuric acid nitric acid se taqatwar acid hai: woh HNO3 ko proton deta hai, jo paani kho kar NO2+ (nitronium ion, electrophile) ban jata hai. Ring NO2+ par hamla karti hai, phir C-H bond toot kar ring wapas aromatic hoti hai aur H+ nikalta hai. Yeh H+ HSO4- se mil kar H2SO4 wapas bana deta hai, is liye H2SO4 catalyst hai.
Zyada darja hararat par ring mein aik se zyada nitro groups aa sakte hain; 50 C par bhi kuch 1,3-dinitrobenzene banta hai: C6H5NO2 + HNO3 -> 1,3-C6H4(NO2)2 + H2O.

blocks.alt: Nitrobenzene + HNO3, teer ke oopar 50 darje C, se 1,3-dinitrobenzene + H2O.
blocks.caption: 1,3-dinitrobenzene ka banna (kitab ke PDF safha 67 ki be-number figure ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: Friedel-Crafts alkylation mein benzene ring mein alkyl group lagta hai; Friedel-Crafts acylation mein acyl group, R-C=O (carbonyl group se jura alkyl group), lagta hai, Lewis acid catalyst ki maujoodgi mein.

items: Alkylation: C6H6 + CH3CH2Cl -> C6H5CH2CH3 (ethylbenzene) + HCl (AlCl3 catalyst, garmi).
Acylation: C6H6 + CH3CH2COCl -> C6H5COCH2CH3 + HCl (AlCl3 catalyst, garmi).

blocks.alt: Friedel-Crafts Alkylation: benzene + CH3CH2Cl, teer ke oopar heat (garmi) aur neeche AlCl3 catalyst, se ethylbenzene + HCl. Friedel-Crafts Acylation: benzene + CH3CH2COCl, garmi aur AlCl3 catalyst, se C(=O)CH2CH3 wali ring + HCl.
blocks.caption: Friedel-Crafts alkylation aur acylation (kitab ke PDF safha 67 ki be-number figure ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

items: Alkylation (teen qadam): Lewis acid AlCl3 alkyl halide se react kar ke carbocation, yani electrophile, banata hai, maslan (CH3)3C-Cl + AlCl3 -> (CH3)3C+ + [AlCl4]- (tertiary carbocation); ring ke pi electrons carbocation par hamla kar ke arenium ion banate hain; darmiyani halat aik proton kho kar aromaticity bahal karti hai, aur proton HCl banata, AlCl3 wapas milta hai.

blocks.alt: (CH3)3C-Cl, Lewis base, Cl par lone pairs, + AlCl3, Lewis acid; Cl ke lone pair se AlCl3 ki taraf mura teer. Is se Cl(+)-AlCl3(-) jo abhi carbon se jura hai, aur C-Cl bond se Cl ki taraf mura teer. Products: 3 darje (tertiary) carbocation (CH3)3C+, electrophile - E+, aur [Cl-AlCl3]-.
blocks.caption: Friedel-Crafts alkylation mein carbocation ka banna (kitab ke PDF safha 67 ki be-number figure ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.alt: Naya carbon-carbon bond: benzene se tertiary carbocation ki taraf mura teer (electrophile ka addition) se sigma complex ki resonance structure, ring ke carbon par H aur C(CH3)3 aur ring mein +. Proton ka nikalna, aromaticity wapas: [Cl-AlCl3]- se H ki taraf mura teer, aur C-H bond se ring ki taraf mura teer; teer ke neeche -AlCl3, product tert-butylbenzene + HCl.
blocks.caption: Friedel-Crafts alkylation ka mechanism (kitab ke PDF safha 68 ki be-number figure ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: AlCl3 (Lewis acid) Cl ka lone pair le leta hai, C-Cl bond toot'ta hai aur (CH3)3C+ carbocation (electrophile) banta hai. Ring is carbocation par hamla kar ke naya C-C bond banati hai. 'Resonance structure' sigma complex ki kai banawaton mein se aik hai: + charge ring ke carbons par ghoomta hai. Aakhir mein [AlCl4]- H+ le kar HCl banata hai aur AlCl3 wapas mil jata hai.

items: Acylation: AlCl3 acyl halide ke saath complex banata, jo halide ion kho kar acylium ion, RCO+, deta hai; ring ke pi electrons acylium ion par hamla karte hain; darmiyani halat se proton hat'ta, ring bahal, HCl banta aur AlCl3 wapas milta hai. Product aryl ketone hai.

blocks.alt: R-C(=O)-Cl, Lewis base, Cl par lone pairs, + AlCl3, Lewis acid, se complex R-C(=O)-Cl(+)-AlCl3(-), jis se acylium ion R-C(+)=O aur [Cl-AlCl3]- bante hain.
blocks.caption: Friedel-Crafts acylation mein acylium ion ka banna (kitab ke PDF safha 68 ki be-number figure ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.alt: Benzene se R-C(+)=O ke carbon ki taraf mura teer (O par lone pair, aur C=O bond se O ki taraf mura teer) se sigma complex ki resonance structure, ring ke aik carbon par H aur C(=O)R aur ring mein +. [Cl-AlCl3]- se H ki taraf mura teer aur C-H bond se ring ki taraf mura teer; teer ke neeche -AlCl3, product aryl ketone, ring par C(=O)R.
blocks.caption: Friedel-Crafts acylation ka mechanism (kitab ke PDF safha 68 ki be-number figure ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Acylation mein electrophile acylium ion R-C(+)=O hai. Is ka + charge O ke lone pair se kuch had tak mustahkam hota hai (C=O teer). Ring is ke carbon par hamla karti hai, sigma complex banta hai, phir [AlCl4]- H+ le kar HCl banata hai aur aromatic ring wapas aati hai. Product aryl ketone hai, maslan R = CH2CH3 ho to C6H5COCH2CH3.

blocks.prompt: AlCl3 catalyst ke saath benzene aur chlorine ke reaction ka mechanism likhein.
blocks.explanation: Cl2 + AlCl3 -> Cl+ + [AlCl4]-; Cl+ ring par hamla karta, sigma complex banta; [AlCl4]- H+ hatata, chlorobenzene + HCl + AlCl3 bante.

blocks.prompt: Nitration mein electrophile kaise banta hai dikhayein. Kaun sa tezaab acid aur kaun sa base ka kaam karta hai?
blocks.explanation: HNO3 + 2H2SO4 -> NO2+ + H3O+ + 2HSO4- (mukhtasar: H2SO4 + HNO3 -> NO2+ + HSO4- + H2O). Sulphuric acid acid (proton dene wala) hai; nitric acid proton leta aur base ka kaam karta hai.

blocks.prompt: AlBr3 ki maujoodgi mein methylbenzene aur bromine ka reaction likhein.
blocks.explanation: Positions 2 aur 4 par ring substitution: C6H5CH3 + Br2 -> 2-bromomethylbenzene aur 4-bromomethylbenzene (mixture) + HBr.

blocks.prompt: Bromine benzene aur phenol se kaise react karta hai?
blocks.explanation: Dono electrophilic substitution hain. Benzene ko maaye bromine aur Lewis acid catalyst (FeBr3 ya AlBr3) chahiye aur bromobenzene + HBr banta hai. Phenol ka OH group ring ko itna fa'aal karta hai ke bromine water kamre ke darja hararat par baghair catalyst react karta, 2,4,6-tribromophenol ka safaid precipitate + 3HBr banta hai.

blocks.prompt: Bromine benzene aur ethylbenzene se kaise react karta hai?
blocks.explanation: Andhere mein Lewis acid catalyst ke saath dono ring substitution karte hain: benzene bromobenzene deta; ethylbenzene tezi se react karta (ethyl group ring ko fa'aal karta) aur 2- aur 4-bromoethylbenzene deta. UV roshni mein baghair catalyst ethylbenzene side chain mein free-radical substitution karta, zyada tar ring ke saath wale CH2 par, (1-bromoethyl)benzene banta; benzene ka ring is tarah substitute nahi hota.

blocks.prompt: Friedel-Crafts reaction se 1,1-dimethylethylbenzene aur methylbenzene mein se kaun aasani se banta hai? Wajah batayein.
blocks.explanation: 1,1-dimethylethylbenzene (tert-butylbenzene): is ka electrophile tertiary carbocation (CH3)3C+ hai, jo teen alkyl groups se mustahkam hota hai, jab ke methylbenzene ko bohat na-mustahkam methyl cation CH3+ chahiye.

items: Teen qadam: E+ banana, hamla (sigma complex), H+ khona.
Halogenation (Br2/AlBr3), nitration (HNO3 + H2SO4 se NO2+), Friedel-Crafts (AlCl3 se R+ ya RCO+).
Lewis acid ya H2SO4 wapas milta: catalyst.
